title: The Markov Accessibility Topology and its Probabilistic Structure
summary: In this paper, we associate a canonical topology with the transition operator of a discrete-time Markov chain. We prove that this construction defines an Alexandroff topology, called the Markov Accessibility Topology, and subsequently establish that it coincides with the Alexandroff topology induced by the accessibility relation. This establishes a direct connection between probabilistic accessibility and order-theoretic topology, allowing several classical notions from Markov chain theory to be interpreted in topological terms.
